_meta.description: Mix two of three colors to match the target. Continuous difficulty, additive & subtractive mixing, surprise inversion stages, dynamic music, turn-based multiplayer, iMessage play, and Apple Watch. No ads, no tracking.
a-round-in-play.92e333: A round in play: the target color above three bubbles
a-short-walk-through.4b3977: A short walk-through teaches light mixing, paint mixing and the inversions that flip between them mid-run, by playing a few guided rounds.
a-simplified-tap-to.9b8b10: A simplified tap-to-mix mode on Apple Watch, for a quick round anywhere.
are-there-ads-iaps.46a41b: Are there ads, IAPs, or subscriptions?
each-round-shows-a.b987b8: Each round shows a target color and three bubbles. Drag two together: one pair, and only one, makes the target.
iphone-and-ipad-universal.8a8058: iPhone and iPad (universal — one purchase covers both), plus a simplified mode on Apple Watch. Built and tuned on iPhone 17 Pro Max.
is-this-the-same.7cd7e3: Is this the same Tri-Add from years ago?
is-tri-add-available.a1e97f: Is Tri-Add available in the European Union?
light-additive-mixing-starts.3da1d7: Light (additive) mixing starts from black and adds toward white — red light + green light makes yellow. Paint (subtractive) mixing starts from white and multiplies toward black — cyan + yellow makes green. Tri-Add teaches both, then flips between them mid-game.
mix-two-of-three.d5c9bd: Mix two of three colors to match the target. Then the rules flip, and light becomes paint.
no-tracking-no-ads.9ce4d2: No tracking. No ads. No in-app purchases.
no-tri-add-is.f4c2a1: No. Tri-Add is a one-time $4.99 purchase. No ads, no tracking, no in-app purchases, no subscriptions — every mode included.
open-the-tri-add.a03afa: Open the Tri-Add iMessage app in a conversation, pick co-op or versus, and take your turn. Send the bubble; your friend taps it, plays their round inside Messages, and sends it back. The match lives entirely in your thread.
original-game-by-austin.1f7b90: Original game by Austin Buck & Blaine Miller · Name by Crystal Buck · © Blaine Miller. All rights reserved.
the-interactive-walk-through.d0a2dc: The interactive walk-through welcoming a new player
the-tri-add-menu.4df8e4: The Tri-Add menu, with Play, Paint Mode and Versus and Co-op
there-s-no-timer.9a2185: There's no timer — the colors get subtler as your level climbs and the preview "help" fades — two peeks early, then one, then none. A built-in perceptual floor keeps every color visibly distinct, even at the top.
tri-add-on-apple.e820e9: Tri-Add on Apple Watch: a target color above three bubbles
what-devices-does-it.b7b7b0: What devices does it run on?
what-s-the-difference.666d2f: What's the difference between light and paint mixing?
yes-it-s-a.3a6fc5: Yes — it's a relaunch of the 2014 original by Austin Buck & Blaine Miller (named by Crystal Buck), rebuilt from scratch in modern Swift. If you owned it before, it's the same app on the App Store, and your old Game Center achievements still count.
yes-tri-add-is.c8644c: Yes. Tri-Add is on the App Store everywhere in the European Union, France included. It's available in every App Store territory Apple offers except South Korea and Vietnam.
